ESCALATION: Epic 2 is now in doing state while bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J (p0) is still open and undecided. That bead determines what the coherent covector a IS and how frame weights compose with a general metric. Epic 2 acceptance already fixes a = w/sum(w), which presumes an answer that is recorded nowhere. R/metric.R does not exist yet, so this is the cheapest moment to settle it.

A fully verified proposal is attached to that bead: compose as K_eff = D(w)^(1/2) K D(w)^(1/2). It reduces to D(w) exactly at K = I (2.2e-16), preserves PSD and the exact Epic 2 component split (sum error 6.9e-18), keeps the coherent amplitude at the raw weighted regional mean (2.8e-17), and yields a closed-form normalizer a^T K_eff^-1 a = (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w) that also resolves bd-01KZXBDP92BNX44VWW08M35VQZ with no factorization.

Conservation is confirmed to HOLD at K = I (2.2e-16) and to be LOST for genuine local precisions (off by O(1)), so it must become a feature-additive-only capability and the README claim needs the same gate as the Epic 8 searchlight-cost claim.

Accept, reject or amend - but please record the decision before R/metric.R lands.
